effects.does: It opens Clara to help generate technical questions for the event.
effects.affects: It can add AI-generated questions to the technical-stage data, but it requires project line items.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara interface opens or reports that line items are required.

effects.does: It opens the attachment interface for adding files.
effects.affects: It adds attachment records to the event when files are selected.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that a file-selection interface appears.

effects.does: It opens the terms-and-conditions interface.
effects.affects: It changes the event terms-and-conditions data that is included when the event is saved or published.
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that terms and conditions can be entered or selected.

effects.does: It opens the line-items management interface.
effects.affects: It changes the event line-item records used by the technical stage and later sourcing stages.
effects.check: Click Items 0 and verify that the line-item management view opens with no items listed.

effects.does: It cannot be clicked because the required line items have not been added.
effects.affects: Nothing is saved while the control remains disabled.
effects.check: Verify that clicking Save as draft produces no action while Items shows 0.

effects.does: It validates the project and attempts to publish the event.
effects.affects: A successful action activates the event and advances it to the published workflow, while validation errors block publication.
effects.leadsTo: Published event or validation error state
effects.check: Click Publish and verify that the event is published only after required title, participants, line items, and stage configuration are valid.

effects.does: It opens the Technical Stage configuration or details.
effects.affects: It changes or exposes the technical-stage setup rather than the RFQ stage.
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify that technical-stage settings are shown.

effects.does: Opens a test or preview of the technical stage.
effects.affects: Does not publish the event, but lets the buyer inspect the configured technical-stage experience.
effects.check: Click Test and verify that a test or preview view opens without publishing the event.

effects.does: It opens evaluator selection for the technical stage.
effects.affects: It assigns an evaluator to the stage or its line-item sections, which is required for technical evaluation.
effects.check: Click Add Evaluator, select an evaluator, and verify that the evaluator appears in the technical-stage configuration.

effects.does: It opens the participant-management interface.
effects.affects: It changes the vendor participants invited to the project.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that vendors can be searched, added, or removed.

effects.does: It opens the terms-and-conditions section.
effects.affects: It changes the terms-and-conditions data used for saving and publishing the event.
effects.check: Click Terms & Conditions and verify that the event's terms configuration is displayed.

effects.does: It opens the stage scheduling control showing the current start time and duration.
effects.affects: It changes the stage start, end, duration, or recurrence schedule.
effects.check: Click the time control and verify that schedule fields can be edited.

effects.does: It displays the Technical Stage tab as the selected stage view.
effects.affects: It changes only the currently displayed stage context.
effects.check: Verify that Technical Stage is highlighted and its fields are visible.

effects.does: It switches the displayed stage to RFQ.
effects.affects: It changes the active stage view from technical evaluation to the RFQ configuration.
effects.check: Click RFQ and verify that RFQ configuration fields replace the technical-stage fields.

effects.does: It navigates to the events list.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event data.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the events listing opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: It accepts or edits the project title.
effects.affects: It changes the event group's title used when saving or publishing.
effects.check: Enter a title and verify that the value remains in the field and is used by the save or publish action.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: It searches for vendors and lets the buyer add eligible results as participants.
effects.affects: It changes the project's participant or audience vendor records.
effects.leadsTo: stays here with the vendor added
effects.check: Search for a vendor, select an enabled result, and verify that the vendor appears in Participants.

effects.does: It displays the line-item number column.
effects.affects: Nothing in the event data or flow.
effects.check: Verify that each displayed line item has a number under this column.

effects.does: It displays the required Specification column for technical-stage items.
effects.affects: Nothing when viewed, while values entered in this column would affect the technical question data.
effects.check: Verify that the Specification heading is present and marked required.

effects.does: It displays the required Description column for technical-stage items.
effects.affects: Nothing when viewed, while values entered in this column would affect the technical question data.
effects.check: Verify that the Description heading is present and marked required.

effects.does: It displays the required Vendor Response column for vendor answers.
effects.affects: Nothing when viewed, while its configured response fields affect the answers vendors can submit.
effects.check: Verify that the Vendor Response heading is present and marked required.

Shown only when not RFQ→Auction, `allow_draft_project_creation` on, not (service-RFP grouping AND `groupServiceActivitiesInRfp`), auctions not routed to the auction team, and the current stage is not recurring — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:292-296, 3343-3345

Stage title "" (auto titles are never empty; reachable in single-stage quick-create) → `errors.title`, no specific toast, only the rollup "<title> - There are some errors in Title, please check and try again" when no other toast fired; not raised for basket + multi-product — src/views/projectCreatio

Publish never stores the returned stage uuids (only Save as draft does), so a retry after a failed project PATCH (e.g. 712) POSTs every stage again — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1826-1839 vs 1516-1536

`draftStageIds` without `projectId` → single draft stage is loaded and its title becomes the project title; with `projectId` → every listed stage is loaded and the last one is selected — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2244-2257, 1157-1161, 1437-1445

Each draft stage → `GET /v1/trade/:id/schema?response_type=template&additional_fields=order_details&l1_prices=true` (plus `&rfq_to_auction=true` when converting), then `GET /companies/audience_for_product?trade_request_uuid=<id>` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1143-1165, src/models/

Stage `status` in the payload = `"draft"` whenever a project id is attached or publishToDraft is true, else `"active"`; so eRFX stages are always created as drafts and go live only through the project PATCH — src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:999-1000
No participant in the project → "Please add participants to proceed!" (stops) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1604-1609

cases.title: Items 0 opens line-item management
cases.expected: The Manage Line Items section opens. The screen indicates that line items must be added before continuing.
cases.setup: Use a new project with zero line items.

steps.note: Start a new project with zero line items.
Activate the empty line-item toolbar control.

args.text: Please add line items to proceed!

steps.note: Verify that the screen explains line items are required before continuing.

cases.title: Save as draft is disabled without line items
steps: Confirm that "Save as draft" cannot be clicked.
cases.expected: "Save as draft" remains disabled. A tooltip shows "Please add line items".
cases.setup: Use a non-RFP stage without line items.

steps.note: Provide a title to isolate the line-item requirement.
Visit the technical stage as the walkthrough does.
Prevent the missing-template gate from masking the expected tooltip.

args.reason: The test requires no line items.

steps.note: Deliberately leave the draft prerequisite unmet.
Assert that saving a draft cannot be clicked.
Hover over the disabled control and assert the reason shown.

cases.title: Blacklisted and TNA vendors cannot be selected
steps: Open "Search vendors you want to add".
View the blacklisted vendor and the TNA vendor in the results.
cases.expected: The blacklisted vendor is disabled and marked "Blocked". The TNA vendor is disabled and marked "TNA". Neither vendor can be selected.
cases.setup: Use a fresh project. Ensure the vendor search results include one blacklisted vendor and one TNA vendor, with no URL option allowing TNA vendors to bid.
gaps: Verify vendor search lists specific blacklisted and TNA vendors and checks their disabled labels in the invite list

cases.title: Publish refuses a project with no line items
cases.expected: The event is not published. The app shows "Line Items are not added, please add them in Manage Line Items section".
cases.setup: Leave the project with zero line items. Enter a project title.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage project creation screen.
Provide a title so an empty title is not the tested omission.
Verify the project still has zero line items.

args.reason: Zero line items is the deliberate publish-validation premise.

args.because: Line Items are not added, please add them in Manage Line Items section

steps.note: Click Publish and require refusal with the exact requested validation wording.

cases.title: Save as draft becomes available after adding a line item
steps: Add one line item in the Manage Line Items section.
Return to the Vendor Assessment screen.
cases.expected: "Save as draft" is enabled and no longer disabled.
cases.setup: Open the screen with no line items, so "Save as draft" is disabled.

plan.title: Draft enabled after adding a technical-stage line item

steps.note: Open line-item management through Items and add one product with a valid default quantity.
Return to the Vendor Assessment screen.
Assert that Save as draft is now enabled.

cases.title: Publish refuses missing payment terms
cases.expected: The event is not published. The app shows "Payment Terms and Conditions are mandatory".
cases.setup: Enter a project title, add at least one line item and participant, and leave payment terms unsaved.

steps.note: Use the technical-plus-RFQ composition from the walk.
Reach the create-technical-template screen as specified.
Supply the required project-level line item.
Complete global and per-item technical questionnaires to avoid unrelated validation failures.
Configure the other stage before testing publication.
Commit a valid schedule so missing scheduling does not cause the refusal.
Return to the technical stage before publishing.

args.because: Payment Terms and Conditions are mandatory

steps.note: Leave payment terms unsaved and assert Publish is refused with the exact required validation wording.
